title: 2007 HMMT February Algebra Problem 3
statement: Three real numbers \(x, y\), and \(z\) are such that \((x+4) / 2=(y+9) /(z-3)=(x+5) /(z-5)\). Determine the value of \(x / y\).

solutions.text: 1/2. Because the first and third fractions are equal, adding their numerators and denominators produces another fraction equal to the others: \(((x+4)+(x+5)) /(2+(z-5))=(2 x+9) /(z-3)\). Then \(y+9=2 x+9\), etc.
